danger_formalization.setting: Living room with furniture including a TV stand, rug, and floor objects.
danger_formalization.robot_task: Pick up a watering can from the floor and place it in front of the TV on the TV stand.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot misinterprets the path and collides with the TV stand while navigating.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Damage to the robot's sensors or structure from impact.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Move forward and turn left incorrectly, hitting the TV stand.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Stop movement, recalculate path using obstacle detection, and navigate around the TV stand.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic obstacle detection but may misinterpret navigation instructions in a cluttered environment.
